data.title: Saniona Appoints Carrie Cook as Chief Business Officer
data.description:
Saniona AB ( (SE:SANION) ) has shared an announcement.

Saniona, a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on neurological and psychiatric disorders, appointed Carrie Cook as chief business officer. She will lead global business development, partnering and alliance management as the company advances its SAN2668 and SAN2465 programs toward clinical trials.

Cook brings more than 25 years of global business development experience across pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, most recently as Sitryx’s chief business officer. Her appointment gives Saniona an executive responsible for business development, partnering and alliance management as its proprietary neurology programs approach Phase 1 trials.

data.title: Kobe Bussan Reports October 2026 Monthly Performance
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Kobe Bussan Co., Ltd. ( (JP:3038) ).

Kobe Bussan, whose release covers the Gyomu Super store network, reported non-consolidated October 2026 sales of ¥52,108 million, up 3.9% year over year. Gross profit was ¥5,278 million, up 2.8%, while operating profit fell 7.8% to ¥2,344 million and ordinary profit increased 43.7% to ¥3,272 million.

During October, seven Gyomu Super stores opened—five in directly managed areas and two in indirectly managed areas—with no closures, taking total stores to 1,157. Nationwide product shipments to all stores rose 3.7% year over year, while full-year figures showed sales up 5.2%, operating profit down 0.2% and ordinary profit down 3.1%; the monthly figures are unaudited and subject to revision.

data.title: Hanwha Investment & Securities Details KRW 19.99 Billion DLB Offering
data.description:
HANWHA INVESTMENT&SECURITIES Co. Ltd. ( (KR:003530) ) has shared an update.

Hanwha Investment & Securities is offering KRW 19,990,000,000 of Hanwha Smart DLB No. 631, an unlisted derivative-linked bond tied to the three-month Korean Treasury Bond rate. The public offering is limited to the Trust Department of IBK Industrial Bank of Korea, with subscription, payment and issuance set for November 27, 2026, and maturity on March 2, 2027.

The prospectus sets pre-tax annual returns of 3.580% if the underlying rate is at least 8% on the maturity valuation date, or 3.570% if it is below 8%, calculated over 95 days. It also warns that the product is not covered by depositor protection, may be difficult to redeem before maturity, and carries issuer credit risk because repayment depends on Hanwha Investment & Securities’ ability to pay.

data.title: Jinhui Provides Details on Three Equity-Based Structured Notes
data.description:
Jinhui Holdings Co. Ltd. ( (HK:0137) ) just unveiled an announcement.

Jinhui Holdings provided additional details about its acquisition of three equity-based structured notes issued by CSI Financial Products Limited, an indirectly owned CITIC Securities subsidiary that issues structured products and conducts derivative transactions. NOTE-1 and NOTE-2 pay fixed coupons linked to underlying shares and may be redeemed early at 100% of principal plus applicable interest if knock-out conditions are met.

If held to maturity, the notes are redeemed at 100% of principal plus interest when underlying prices meet strike prices; otherwise, the company may receive shares at strike prices, with downside exposure limited to the relevant principal. NOTE-3 is a CNH5 million fixed-coupon note linked to the CSI Smallcap 500 Index, with automatic termination if the index closes at or above the applicable knock-out barrier on an observation date.
